decision: resolve PAYWALL-TEST-01 by direct source review; native execution and candidate render pending
actual_read_coverage: Shared measure helper and its locale/direction/Dynamic Type environment setup
Initial review finding and original file bindings

rationale: At the same 100-point width, the test measures heading-only detail and an independent standalone caption Text with unconstrained vertical intrinsic size. The row must reserve at least their combined heights (within 0.5-point tolerance); the extra 1-point VStack spacing makes this conservative.
A wrapping heading alone no longer satisfies the assertion: its measured height appears on both sides, and full lesson height is additionally required.

The natural Russian long-title fixture explicitly must exceed twice its wide one-line height. A restored one- or two-line cap therefore cannot satisfy the complete-lesson-height requirement for this fixture.

All four fixtures run in LTR and RTL and at explicit .large and .xxxLarge, covering the horizontal-track Dynamic Type range requested. The shared measure helper pins locale to en_US and applies requested direction and size, avoiding dependence on ambient simulator text size.
Using Text(verbatim:) makes these controlled literal layout fixtures. This verifies intrinsic size reservation rather than localized-resource lookup, which remains outside this unit test.

remaining_limits: No iOS hosted tests were run by this Windows reviewer. Assertions are accepted by source analysis, not claimed empirically passing.
The helper test does not render the whole TrackLayout, scroll view or pinned CTA; candidate native renders must verify full title visibility, timeline separation and scroll reachability.
No blanket all-locale visual or human-native certification.
